name: assistant-analytics
description: four analytics questions answered live from Salesmessage data
observedAt: 2026-08-09 - contacts and calls measured live; credit questions estimated at 35s
provenance: Selectors observed live. Generation times: 2 of 4 measured, 2 estimated and marked ESTIMATED in the script.
intro: Salesmessage MCP Server | A demo of live analytics, asked in plain English
outro: Thanks for watching | Do you have any questions? Follow up with us any time - we are happy to help
warnings:
BEFORE THE FIRST TAKE, dismiss the notify banner by hand on the pipeline profile.
claude.ai shows a "Want to be notified when Claude responds?" banner during long
generations, and while it is up BOTH the Send and Stop controls are absent from
the DOM - Enter does nothing and the take stalls. Dismissing it once appears to
suppress it for that profile, but productvideos/profile is a DIFFERENT profile
from your everyday Chrome, so dismissing it there does not help the take.
Do it in the same sitting as the sign-in step.

Trimmed from the eight questions in mcp.flow. Dropped: conversations, messages,
team response times, and "break that down by agent" - that last one answers
"there is nothing to break down" on this account, because only one member has
measurable conversations. Verified live on 2026-08-09.

narration: Salesmessage analytics, asked in plain English - no dashboard, no filters, no query builder.
Claude picks the Salesmessage connector and calls the contacts endpoint itself.
These are the account own numbers, read live rather than from a cached report.
